BiblicalUsage: Baalath-beer was a town in the south, in the inheritance of Simeon — Ramath of the south, the town on the edge of the desert. It is named once, in the border list of Joshua.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the towns on the desert edge count as much as the towns in the hills, because God gave Simeon its portion too.
